Mississippi State Senate
2026 Regular Session
YEAS AND NAYS On H. C. R. No. 65. On motion of Senator Wiggins, the rules
were suspended, the resolution considered engrossed, read the third time and, the yeas
and nays being taken, it failed to be adopted, title standing as stated, by the following
vote, a two-thirds vote being required:
Yeas--Barrett, Berry, Boyd, Carter, Chassaniol, Chism, DeBar, DeLano, England,
Fillingane, Harkins, Hartness, Hill, Hopson, Johnson, Kirby, Ladner, McCaughn,
McLendon, McMahan, Michel, Parks, Rhodes, Seymour, Sparks, Suber, Tate, Taylor,
Thompson, Whaley, Wiggins, Williams, Younger. Total--33.
Nays--Barnett, Blackmon, Blount, Brumfield, Bryan, Butler, DuPree, Frazier,
Gillespie Isom, Hickman, Jackson, Mumford, Norwood, Pope, Simmons D. T. (12th),
Simmons S. (13th), Thomas, Turner-Ford. Total--18.
Absent and those not voting--Blackwell. Total--1.
